mainEntity.name: When should my business consider implementing Customer Query Research for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your business should consider implementing Customer Query Research for AEO when you observe a significant portion of your target audience using search engines to ask direct questions, or when your current content isn't effectively ranking for featured snippets or 'People Also Ask' sections. It's particularly beneficial if you want to enhance your brand's authority, improve organic visibility, and capitalize on the growth of voice search. Proactively adopting AEO ensures your content aligns with evolving search behaviors and positions your business as a go-to information source.
acceptedAnswer.description: Implement when your audience asks direct questions to search engines, your content lacks featured snippet visibility, or you want to enhance authority and capitalize on voice search.
